title: Handle nonrepresentable live UnitIds in replay-local SCR output
description: Shipping regression on bo99-primal-g1.rep (SHA-256 d254009025035b03e704d36647b718268e7876411d7b83559b07a47cd628448b): production bwsim-only backend loads and simulates until frame 6508, then sim.toReplayUnitId(8193) returns null for a live assimilator owned by player 1 in replay-local namespace. Adapter correctly fails loudly per bwf-8uu, but ordinary analysis aborts. Determine whether legacy ShieldBattery emitted a usable ID for engine-created/nonrepresentable units and whether upstream headless-bwsim needs an output-namespace API policy/capability.
notes:
Root cause proven 2026-08-23. Fixture is supported BW 1.21+ Melee ZvP, Polypoid 1.75, header 13027. Full scan finds exactly one nonrepresentable lifetime: native ID 8193/index 0 is neutral Vespene Geyser frames 1..6507, then morphs in place to owner-1 Assimilator frames 6508..13027; no other null conversion. 8193=0x2001 has low slot component 1, outside v0.1.4 translated range 0x06a4..0x0ea3. Historical Shield unit_timeline.rs serializes UnitArray::to_unique_id() directly, proving legacy timeline identity is hybrid engine identity rather than a globally replay-local command namespace. Recommended smallest adapter policy: keep native IDs internally; serialize sim.toReplayUnitId(nativeId) when representable, otherwise preserve nativeId for low-slot legacy units, with an emitted-live-ID collision check. No vendored patch; likely BW Forge output compatibility rule using existing upstream API. Prior fail-loud rule correctly exposed the unsupported assumption.
Implemented adapter-only hybrid serialization. Native IDs remain keys for current/previous maps and disappearance/death detection. Loaded replay-local null conversion now preserves native low-slot ID; distinct-native-to-same-serialized collision fails loudly for live and death sets. Exact bo99 replay completes frames 1..13027 through dev and rebuilt win-unpacked package; frame 6508 emits new incomplete Assimilator ID 8193 alongside existing converted Assimilator ID 3738 without collision. Both player ZIPs have all six members byte-identical between dev and packaged runs. Gates: CLI 18, desktop 45, corpus-query 49, Python 32, all pass; full typecheck and pack:dir pass.
close_reason: Hybrid legacy UnitId serialization implemented with collision protection; exact Melee regression replay completes through development and unpacked production runtimes with deterministic artifacts and all gates passing.

Focused SCR ID namespace pass started 2026-08-23. v0.1.3 calculates ScrUnitIdMode during load but Bwsim discards it; public package root and Bwsim API expose no selected namespace accessor. Per task constraint, no adapter heuristic will be duplicated. Proceeding with ID-flow, inverse-domain, golden, and native-control proof before documenting the upstream API requirement.
Focused proof complete 2026-08-23. ShieldBattery uses UnitArray::to_unique_id for both live records and cloned disappearance deaths. Python uses live IDs transiently for morph/queue correlation; reduced exposure is deaths.json in player ZIP/standalone HTML, while SQLite/MCP drops IDs. On pvt_mid the checked inverse maps 36/36 deaths and 598,022/598,022 common live records exactly, covering generations 1-5 and 19 reused components; valid nonzero slotPart domain is 0x06a4..0x0ea3. Native controls remain direct: tvp_mid 28/28 deaths and LastReplay 426/426 relevant deaths. No adapter patch: v0.1.3 computes ScrUnitIdMode during load but discards it and does not export a public accessor; reclassification after normalized DRPL storage is unsafe. Required upstream capability: retain/expose original not-applicable/native/translated mode (preferably checked inverse helper), then refresh vendor and serialize all emitted live IDs at the compatibility boundary while internal maps stay native. See docs/bwsim-scr-unit-id-parity.md.

The literal-Melee pvt_mid fixture is fixed by v0.1.3 and no competitive action defect remains.
acceptance_criteria: Both UMS fixtures conform to ShieldBattery downstream artifacts under a current upstream release, or BW Forge rejects/documents them explicitly as unsupported before reduction.
notes:
v0.1.2 follow-up (2026-08-22): vendored exact upstream tag v0.1.2 / commit 31d7613f9dfec86897c69ea2e69e6f55ac19724e; all 29 runtime files hash-match upstream and pinned Wasm/pack hashes are unchanged. The total no-action symptom is removed: zvt_mid/tvz_mid/pvt_mid mine and produce, reach expected terminal frames 21949/11950/11819, and production reruns are byte-identical at JSONL and ZIP-member level. Acceptance is NOT met: downstream remains materially wrong. Build-order totals Shield/bwsim are 421/22, 154/27, and 103/71; supply, minerals/gas/workers, unit counts, and deaths all differ for every affected player. Player metadata matches; zvt duration differs by accepted PlayerLeave+1 and pvt by the separate Shield header+1 issue. Full unchanged 19-replay rerun: 38/38 final backend/reducer successes, 9 exact after accepted gathered/Scanner normalization, 1 accepted-only, 9 unexplained. The four smaller blockers all still reproduce. Keep this P0 open and return the partial SCR replay execution result upstream; do not default bwsim. Detailed report: docs/bwsim-corpus-conformance.md v0.1.2 follow-up.
Game-type audit (2026-08-22): screp headers show zvt_mid and tvz_mid are Use Map Settings; pvt_mid is literal Melee. The issue is therefore not UMS-specific and remains a general SCR replay-execution bug, although the two UMS fixtures must not be used alone to infer ordinary Melee UnitId semantics. Full corpus split: 17 baseline competitive/Melee-style fixtures (3 Melee, 14 Top vs Bottom), 2 UMS, no other nonstandard types. Baseline-only v0.1.2 result is 9 exact, 1 accepted-only, 7 unexplained (7/17 vs 9/19 overall). See docs/bwsim-corpus-conformance.md game-type audit.
v0.1.3 competitive follow-up (2026-08-23): pvt_mid is fixed end-to-end for action/state semantics: 103/103 build events, zero missing/extra/timing differences, supply exact, economy exact through header 11819, counts exact after Scanner, and all 36 deaths exact on durable fields. The remaining header+1 mismatch belongs to bwf-7ln. v0.1.3 UMS behavior was intentionally not investigated. This issue is narrowed from the former general/P0 silent-action blocker to separate UMS compatibility and no longer blocks a competitive-only verdict.
2026-08-23 product decision: BW Forge ships bwsim-only with competitive Melee/Top-vs-Bottom as the supported baseline; UMS compatibility is explicitly not guaranteed. This issue is UMS-only and non-blocking for this release.
